look.why: A clear savanna sky, the complement of the amber patches: the tallest animal gets the sky.

size.measure: height to the ossicones: up to 5.7 m, a typical adult about 5 m

habitat.text: Dry savannas, open woodlands and scrub across Africa, south of the Sahara.

diet.text: Mostly acacia leaves, grabbed with a 45 cm tongue. A big male eats up to 66 kg a day!

facts.text: That huge neck has just 7 bones, the same number as yours!
Calves drop about 2 m to the ground at birth. Welcome to the world!
